text: Swap the letters by a fixed code alphabet, then shuffle them: the order the Zodiac killer's 340 used. Then the same message letter always lands as the same carved letter, wherever the shuffle puts it.
For each of ten million moves built since 0106, follow the 24 known letters to their carved places: the three Es must show one carved letter, the two As another, and so on, all different.
No move passes on K4 or on ten scrambled copies; a planted text does. The three largest compiled libraries follow in 0198.
